senses.gloss: f. pl. (v. חֲצִיצָה) intermediate contacts, laws concerning the shaking of an object by an unclean person through a partition (v. חָצִיץ).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:7:3">Y. Ḥag. II, end, 78ᶜ</cite> (v. emendation in R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 7:5">Toh. VII, 5</cite>).
